name: should create a query for the four projected valuation columns across all periods
description: Covers the columns the 2026-08-18 adj retirement renamed. All four are requested TOGETHER and across all three periods, because each is provably correct when requested alone: a defect in the alias key collapses two periods into one join group and renders one period's value under another period's header. There was zero golden coverage of any of these ids before this fixture. The WEEK column carries an explicit week param because its rows are week-keyed and the request resolves no week otherwise; this fixture ran without one until 2026-08-29 and emitted week = 0 for it -- a season value under a week header while the periods shared one table, and no matching row at all once they split.
